PLAN "Bodyweight Strength Foundations (Home, Pull-up Bar Only) + Nutrition + Home Cardio + Mobility"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational strength with bodyweight and pull-up bar"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Support muscle growth and recovery with balanced nutrition"
  GOAL secondary cardio:
    name "Improve cardiovascular fitness with home-based modalities"
  GOAL secondary mobility:
    name "Enhance mobility and flexibility for injury prevention and movement quality"

SUMMARY
  PHASE "Phase 1: Fundamentals" (Weeks 1-4):
    - 3x/week strength (Full Body A/B)
    - 1x/week home cardio (Wednesday)
    - 1x/week fun finisher (Saturday)
    - 1x/week mobility flow (Sunday)
    - Focus: learn movement patterns, build base strength, establish routine

  PHASE "Phase 2: Progression" (Weeks 5-8):
    - 3x/week strength (Full Body A/B, higher sets/reps, higher RPE)
    - 1x/week home cardio (Wednesday, longer duration)
    - 1x/week fun finisher (Saturday, more volume)
    - 1x/week mobility flow (Sunday)
    - Focus: increase intensity, push volume, challenge endurance and strength

  PHASE "Phase 3: Advanced Bodyweight" (Weeks 9-12):
    - 3x/week strength (Full Body A/B, advanced volume/intensity)
    - 1x/week home cardio (Wednesday, longest duration)
    - 1x/week fun finisher (Saturday, highest volume)
    - 1x/week mobility flow (Sunday)
    - Focus: maximize bodyweight strength, muscular endurance, maintain mobility

  WEEKLY STRUCTURE (all phases):
    - Monday: Full Body A (strength)
    - Wednesday: Home Cardio (intervals, bodyweight)
    - Thursday: Full Body B (strength)
    - Saturday: Fun Finisher (high-intensity, circuit style)
    - Sunday: Mobility Flow (full-body mobility and flexibility)

  KEY EXERCISES:
    - Upper body: push_up, incline_press, pull_up, chin_up, plank, hollow_hold
    - Lower body: squat, lunge
    - Cardio: jumping_jack, high_knees, mountain_climber, jump_rope, jogging_in_place, butt_kicks
    - Finishers: burpee, mountain_climber, push_up, squat, plank
    - Mobility: arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, cat_cow, forward_fold, pigeon_pose, spinal_twist, butterfly_stretch, child_pose

  INTENSITY PROGRESSION:
    - Phase 1: RPE 6-8, moderate sets/reps
    - Phase 2: RPE 9, higher sets/reps, shorter rest
    - Phase 3: RPE 9, peak sets/reps, advanced endurance

  NUTRITION:
    - Calories: maintenance + 250
    - Protein: 1.6..2.2 g/kg bodyweight
    - Carbs: moderate to high
    - Fat: moderate
    - Hydration: 2.5..3.5 L water daily
    - 3..5 meals/day, protein at each meal, whole foods focus

  EQUIPMENT RECOMMENDATIONS:
    - Adjustable dumbbells (20..30kg+ per hand)
    - Adjustable kettlebell (12..24kg)
    - Resistance bands (light, medium, heavy)
    - Weighted vest (up to 10..20kg)
    - Door anchor for bands
    - Optional: foldable bench, gymnastic rings

  WEEKLY SCHEDULE EXAMPLE:
    - Monday: Strength (Full Body A)
    - Wednesday: Cardio (Home Cardio)
    - Thursday: Strength (Full Body B)
    - Saturday: Fun Finisher (circuit)
    - Sunday: Mobility Flow

  PROGRESSION:
    - Increase sets, reps, and RPE each phase
    - Cardio intervals increase in duration and intensity
    - Finishers become more challenging
    - Mobility routine remains consistent for recovery and flexibility

  OUTCOME:
    - Improved full-body strength, muscle, cardiovascular fitness, and mobility
    - Sustainable home routine with minimal equipment
    - Foundation for future weighted or advanced calisthenics training
